content:
tasha: New dev trying the Windows quickstart (PowerShell). Followed README, set REDWOOD_KEY in env, ran npm run start, but first API POST returns 402 Payment Required. Web console shows 'trial active' though. Anyone seen this mismatch?

ben: Is this an invite or SSO org? Also, can you paste the exact curl and response body?

tasha: Invite link. Curl from host works but the app call fails. Minimal curl and response:```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $env:REDWOOD_KEY" \\n  -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hey"}]}'

HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":{"type":"billing_required","message":"workspace payment required","billing_url":"https://app.redwood.ai/workspaces/wn-777/billing"}}
```

mike: Try GET /v1/workspaces/me — I've seen the frontend flip to "trial" before backend provisioning completes, especially for invite flows.

tasha: GET /v1/workspaces/me -> {"id":"wn-777","state":"initializing"} even though UI banner says trial enabled.

ben: Two quick DX bugs we've been finding: (1) some quickstart binaries on Windows prefer %APPDATA%/redwood/credentials over env var without clear logs, (2) older SDK default retry configs will reissue the POST several times which makes the user see multiple 402s and confusing output.

tasha: I printed process.env from the app and REDWOOD_KEY is present. But the starter log prints "using key from file" (masked) — I didn't realize the app prefers file over env.

mike: That explains host curl vs app: host curl uses your env token, app used a stale file token. We should change starter to prefer env when present and to log the key source loudly.

devops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-211 onboarding-initializing-state-and-key-precedence \u2014 https://go.redwood.ai/inc/INC-2026-211

ben: Short-term fixes: add a preflight check in quickstarts: GET /v1/workspaces/me and wait for state=="active" (poll with backoff up to 60s) before making the first interactive request; prefer env var for REDWOOD_KEY and print chosen source; and change SDK retry defaults to not retry on 4xx billing_required.

tasha: I hacked the local starter to prefer env and added a tiny spinner while polling workspaces/me. After ~28s the state flipped to active and the first POST succeeded.

starter-bot: Issue opened: redwood-inference/starter#988 "windows: prefer REDWOOD_KEY env over credentials file + preflight workspace check" (contains repro and patch suggestion)

sdk-team: Filed SDK ticket SDK-556: "Expose wait_for_workspace_ready helper and do not auto-retry on 402 billing_required". We'll include a convenience helper in next SDK patch.

ben: We'll merge a small PR to change key precedence and add a visible log line like "Using REDWOOD_KEY from env (••••••)" so it's obvious. Also adding a troubleshooting blurb in quickstart README: 'If you get 402 right after signup, check /workspaces/me and your credential source.'

tasha: Thanks — PRs look good. Reopening if I hit it again, but this unblocked me. :white_check_mark:
